info.title: Deactivated Numbers API
info.description:
**Encoding:** Accepts only UTF-8 encoded unicode characters as inputs.

The Deactivated Numbers API can be used to get lists of deactivated numbers. These can be used to ensure you don't send SMS messages to these numbers using our SMS and SMS Verify products.

get.description:
Use this action to get a list of files accessible for you to download that contain deactivated phone numbers.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Responds with:** `application/json`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

200.description: **Success.** Your request was fulfilled and a file was retrieved. Note that no response JSON object is returned in the payload, only the contents of the file itself.

get.description:
Use this action to download one specified file that contains deactivated phone numbers.

## General requirements
* **Authentication:** [Basic](/enterprise/docs/authentication#basic-authentication) (easiest to implement) or [Digest](/enterprise/docs/authentication#digest-authentication)
* **Encoding:** Accepts only **UTF-8 unicode** characters as inputs.
* **Responds with:** `application/json` or `application/octet-stream`
* **Rate limit:** [Default rate limits by product](https://support.telesign.com/s/article/do-you-have-any-rate-limits)

Basic.description: Easiest to implement. See [Basic Authentication](/api-reference/authentication#basic-authentication) for more details.

list_of_files.description: Each element in this array is the name of a compressed file containing deactivated numbers. Use these filenames with the `/download/{file_name}` endpoint to download the available files as needed.
